purpose: Two-track runtime/distribution boundary for normal clone-user Web execution and optional Electron release shell packaging.

source_web.name: Clone-user Python Headless Web
source_web.role: Default user execution path from a git clone or source checkout.

electron_release.name: Electron release shell
electron_release.role: Maintainer/release path that wraps the same Python backend and Remote Web UI.

hard_rules: The source_web track is the default product path and must run without npm, Electron, Docker, or bundled Python.
Remote-published source excludes tests/ and other local development-only validation surfaces.
The electron_release track is a shell and release-maintainer path only.
Both tracks must use the same core/web_session_app.py backend API.
Both tracks must use app/web/remote as the only source-owned Remote Web UI.
Electron must not introduce a second feature implementation for prompt processing, generation dispatch, or queue behavior.
ui/remote_web must remain removed from source ownership.
